name: Can smoke smell be completely removed from an apartment?

mainEntity.name: Can smoke smell be completely removed from an apartment?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, with professional fire restoration techniques, smoke smell can be completely removed from an apartment. Lingering smoke odors are caused by microscopic soot particles that embed themselves in porous materials. Professionals use specialized equipment like ozone generators, thermal foggers, and industrial air scrubbers to neutralize these odors at their source. They also perform thorough cleaning of all affected surfaces and contents. Attempting to mask the smell with air fresheners is ineffective as it does not address the underlying problem and the odor will eventually return.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, professional fire restoration can completely remove smoke smells using specialized equipment and thorough cleaning to neutralize embedded soot particles.
